prompt:
One continuous NINE-second shot at natural real-time speed, starting exactly from the supplied image. Absolute locked tripod camera throughout: no zoom, dolly, pan, reframing, cuts or background drift. This is a full-width plate for a later sliding split-screen; DO NOT generate any split-screen or slide. Keep the person seated in the same screen position and scale, head and gestures within the original shoulder/elbow area. Preserve exact mature graphic-novel drawing, face, costume, anatomy, phone, coiled cord, furniture and architecture. No extra people, captions or music. Silent conversational mouth movements, not singing. One second moving lead and one second living tail; no frozen beginning or end.
PENNY'S PERSONALITY: the petite pink-haired young woman believes this call will launch her interviewing career. She has rehearsed being a sophisticated media professional, but her unstoppable eagerness keeps bursting through. Endearing ambitious confidence, not manic randomness or malice. Her private little tic is tidying her oversized blazer as though the caller could see her. Preserve her freckles, separate expressive brows, pink bob, barrettes, petrol blazer and patterned scarf.
0–1s: she smoothly brings the existing yellow receiver the short distance up to her ear with the same hand, bright expectant eyes; her free pen-holding hand makes ONE small neat lapel-straightening gesture. Keep the pen securely between fingers. Do not swap hands or drop props.
1–3s: with receiver now comfortably at ear, she sits taller, lifts her chin and begins an elaborately polished introduction, brows lifted, a confident little nod. The pen hand stays close to her chest or above the open organizer.
3–5.5s: her genuine excitement breaks through the practiced formality. She leans slightly forward, bright smile broadens, eyebrows dance, and her pen makes two or three small brisk conducting gestures above the desk as she enthusiastically explains her irresistible pitch. Clear purposeful conversational gestures, not waving wildly. She is cheerfully oblivious to how alarming her information sounds to the other person.
5.5–7.5s: she pauses to listen for a brief beat, gives a delighted knowing eyebrow lift, then resumes with a small persuasive pen point and eager nod, certain she has impressed him. No fear or anger. Keep her face visible, hands below face.
7.5–9s: still listening with a proud hopeful smile and small living movements, pen settles above organizer. Remain engaged, no hang-up or new gag. Phone stays at ear after initial lift; cord stays attached; seated body position stable. Prioritize readable changes of thought and expressive eyes over large gestures.
PROMPT LOCK: Mature graphic-novel ink-and-paint; distinct character silhouettes; quieter layered backdrops. Narrator addresses audience and is imperceptible to residents. Preserve approved identities, costumes and lyric timing.
